objective: Replace the five visible Shire garden patches' primitive cube/sphere treatment with already-resident production ground and shrub assets while preserving authored locations and low-spec budgets.

source_basis.project_world_bible: 03_WORLD_LOCATIONS_AND_MAP_BIBLE: The Shire/Hobbiton visual grammar = warm domestic scale; circular doors; gardens.

replacement_contract.primitive_fallback: Cube soil rows and Sphere plants remain only when the exact resident production meshes/HISM binding are unavailable.
replacement_contract.actor_count_effect: Production path removes up to 125 individual primitive plant actors and replaces them with HISM instances; no new per-plant Actor/Tick authority.

evidence_boundary: SOURCE-IMPLEMENTED pending exact-head Pre-Unreal and UE4.27.2 validation. No PIE, device, visual or performance acceptance.
